harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent ufw firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04): default-deny incoming, default-allow outgoing, with explicit ALLOW rules for 22/tcp (SSH) and 8080/tcp (both IPv4 and IPv6). ufw is enabled and systemd-enabled for boot persistence. Verified via ufw status, raw iptables ufw-user-input chain, and /etc/ufw/user.rules + ufw.conf. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified post-restart that ufw was active with the same SSH/8080 rules, sshd was active, and a live listener on 8080 was reachable per ss.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 16.04), available firewall tooling (ufw/iptables), sshd port (22), and pre-existing listeners
Set ufw default deny incoming / allow outgoing
Added ufw allow rules for 22/tcp and 8080/tcp
Enabled ufw non-interactively (--force enable) and systemctl enable ufw for boot persistence
Verified ufw status, iptables ufw-user-input chain, /etc/ufw/user.rules, and /etc/ufw/ufw.conf ENABLED=yes

Ran and cleaned up test listeners on 8080 and an unrelated port (9999) to sanity-check the rule set (noted self-IP loopback routing made that specific test non-authoritative, relied on ruleset inspection instead)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline
Issued shutdown -r now via backgrounded sudo so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart and re-verified ufw active with identical rules, sshd active, and 8080 reachable

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and rejects unrelated inbound (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Baseline captured (ufw inactive, no rules), then ufw configured with default deny incoming, allow 22/tcp and 8080/tcp; iptables ufw-user-input chain and /etc/ufw/user.rules confirm the persisted rule set; ufw.conf shows ENABLED=yes and systemctl is-enabled ufw returns enabled

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (b185f188-...), boot time, ufw active status, and sshd active status

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node restarted
evidence.summary: Backgrounded shutdown -r now command returned/acknowledged before the SSH connection was closed by the remote host, confirming the restart was issued and not merely a service bounce

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: proof node became unavailable then available again
evidence.summary: First poll got connection refused during reboot; second poll succeeded once node1 came back up

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (c54b62d5-...) differs from pre-restart boot_id (b185f188-...), and boot time advanced from 09:07:59 to 09:09:19

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: firewall and services recovered post-restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart ufw status verbose shows active with identical 22/tcp and 8080/tcp allow rules and deny-incoming default; iptables ufw-user-input chain shows the same ACCEPT rules; sshd active; a live nc listener on 8080 was confirmed reachable via ss, then cleaned up
